archival_replay.counter_scope: Recorded nonnegative bounds and retained-move aggregation, not independently replayed LP operation traces.
archival_replay.h_scope: Exact labelled-source bounds; no invariance or general monotonicity under retriangulation.
archival_replay.historical_pins_scope: Generation-time metadata; replayed proofs are checked with current pinned verifiers.
archival_replay.staged_scope: Separate preprocessing and source queries; assembled proofs are not fresh whole-driver calls.

strict32_prerequisite.h_scope: Upper bounds on the exact terminal sources; no invariance under retriangulation.
strict32_prerequisite.historical_pins_scope: Generation-time metadata, not current-source pin assertions.
